units.source_text: 夜间天空自始至终就是这样运动着。

en.t: All through the night, the sky kept moving in just that way.

units.source_text: 但是，民就这么个程度，没有更凶猛的迹象。

en.t: But that was as far as it went; there were no signs of anything more violent.
I leaned against the railing and fell asleep.

units.source_text: 翌日清晨是个大晴天，寺庙的老仆来把我唤醒，告诉我飓风幸好已过京都市郊了。

en.t: Early the next morning was brilliantly clear, and an old servant from the temple came to wake me, telling me that the typhoon had fortunately already passed beyond the outskirts of Kyoto.
